facts: On 20 June 2024, property was dishonestly moved out of another person's possession without consent.
On 12 July 2024, movable property was dishonestly taken from another person's possession without consent.
The alleged act occurred on 18 June 2024 and intentionally caused another person's death.
On 12 July 2024, a person was deceived and dishonestly induced to deliver property.
A deceptive course of conduct continued from 20 June 2024 until 12 July 2024 and caused delivery of property.
A complaint alleges dishonest inducement and delivery of property, but does not state when the conduct occurred.
On 12 July 2024, a crime syndicate carried out continuing unlawful activity involving repeated serious offences.
On 12 July 2024, death was allegedly caused by rash and negligent driving and the driver left without reporting the incident.
On 20 June 2024, repeated unwanted following and electronic monitoring caused fear and distress.
On 12 July 2024, a person was wrongfully prevented from leaving a confined place.
